people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.
translations.bsb: Saul promptly began to proclaim Jesus in the synagogues, declaring, “He is the Son of God.”
translations.kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
translations.asv: And straightway in the synagogues he proclaimed Jesus, that he is the Son of God.
